name: LoadRunner Performance Testing
certifications: Assessed by scripts, scenarios and an analysis report
tools: APM tool such as Dynatrace or AppDynamics

beginner.summary: For performance testers starting with LoadRunner, sold today under the OpenText Performance Engineering names. Covers performance testing concepts, the LoadRunner components, installation, protocols, recording Web HTTP/HTML scripts in VuGen, script structure, replay and run-time settings, transactions, think time, parameterisation, correlation, checkpoints, rendezvous points, C functions in scripts, debugging, Controller scenarios, load generators, monitors, Analysis, SLAs and a first load test report.
prerequisites: Basic programming knowledge helps for the C scripting days
outcomes: Record, correlate and parameterise reliable Web HTTP/HTML scripts in VuGen
Design and run manual and goal-oriented scenarios in the Controller with load generators
Analyse results in Analysis with SLAs and server monitors
Write a clear performance test report from a LoadRunner run

days.topic: LoadRunner Overview, Components and Installation Setup
subtopics: Performance testing goals and test types
The LoadRunner family: Professional, Enterprise and Cloud
VuGen, Controller, load generators and Analysis
days.lab_task: Install LoadRunner Professional with the sample application, open each component, record a short script in VuGen and replay it once.
days.deliverable: Working installation and a first replayed script
objectives: Record and replay a first script

subtopics: What a protocol is in LoadRunner
Citrix, SAP GUI and other enterprise protocols
days.lab_task: Analyse two sample applications with Protocol Advisor and browser tools, choose a protocol for each and write the reasons.
checks: Each application has a chosen protocol

days.topic: Recording Web HTTP/HTML Scripts in VuGen
days.lab_task: Record login, search and checkout as one journey with HTML-based mode, filter third-party requests, add comments and clean up the script.
checks: Steps are commented by business action

days.topic: Script Structure: vuser_init, Action and vuser_end
subtopics: What belongs in init and end
days.lab_task: Restructure the script so login is in vuser_init, business steps are in separate actions and logout is in vuser_end, and run five iterations.
checks: Login, actions and logout are in the right sections
Actions are named by business step

subtopics: Settings for debugging compared with load
days.lab_task: Configure run-time settings for debugging with extended logs and for load with minimal logs, pacing and cache emulation, and compare replay times.
checks: Debug and load settings are saved separately

subtopics: Business transactions compared with technical steps
days.lab_task: Add a transaction for each business step with consistent names, add think time outside transactions and confirm transaction times in the replay summary.
days.deliverable: Script with transactions and think time
checks: Each business step is a transaction
Transaction times appear in the replay summary

subtopics: Parameter types: file, unique, random and date
Select next row and update value on options
days.lab_task: Parameterise usernames, passwords and search terms from a file with unique allocation per virtual user, and simulate the values for twenty users.
checks: Hard-coded values are replaced by parameters
Each virtual user gets unique login data
The data file has enough rows for the planned load

days.lab_task: Find the dynamic values in the checkout script, correlate the session token and order ID with web_reg_save_param_ex and replay for ten virtual users.

subtopics: Checks that cost little under load
days.lab_task: Add text checks for each business step and for error pages, force one check to fail and confirm the transaction fails in the replay log.
checks: Each step has a text check
The failed check is visible in results

days.lab_task: Add a rendezvous point before checkout, configure a policy that releases fifty users together and compare checkout times with a normal run.
checks: The rendezvous point is placed before checkout

days.topic: C Functions and Logic in Scripts
days.lab_task: Add logic that picks a random product from search results, retries a failed step once and writes custom messages to the log.
checks: A random product is chosen from results
Custom messages appear in the log

days.lab_task: Diagnose four failing scripts (a missed correlation, an exhausted parameter, a failed check and a wrong header), fix them and write a debugging checklist.
checks: Each failure has a recorded cause
The checklist covers the steps used

subtopics: Adding scripts and virtual user groups
days.lab_task: Build a manual scenario with two scripts in groups, a ramp-up, steady state and ramp-down schedule, run it and save the results.
checks: Groups and schedules match the plan
Live graphs are monitored during the run

subtopics: Goal types: virtual users, hits, transactions and pages
days.lab_task: Run a goal-oriented scenario targeting transactions per second, compare how load was applied with the manual scenario and record when each type is better.
checks: The scenario targets a transaction rate
Results show whether the goal was met
The two scenario types are compared

days.lab_task: Add two load generators, distribute groups between them, monitor their CPU and memory during a run and show they were not the bottleneck.
checks: Both generators are ready in the Controller

subtopics: Web server and application server monitors
days.lab_task: Add server, database and network monitors to the scenario, run it and line up resource use with transaction response times in the Controller.
checks: Server and database metrics are captured
Metrics are viewed with response times
The relationship between load and resources is described

subtopics: Running virtual users and hits per second
days.lab_task: Open a run in Analysis, filter to steady state, overlay response time with running virtual users and export an HTML report with the key graphs.
checks: Response time is overlaid with virtual users
The HTML report contains the key graphs

days.topic: SLAs and Pass or Fail Criteria
days.lab_task: Define SLAs for three business transactions from the requirements, apply them in Analysis and report which transactions met their SLAs.
checks: Each SLA has a metric and threshold

days.lab_task: Write a performance test report from a LoadRunner run with a summary, SLA results, two bottlenecks, recommendations and go or no-go advice.
checks: The summary states the outcome plainly
SLA results are presented per transaction

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: LoadRunner Test of a Web Application
days.lab_task: Plan and run a LoadRunner test of a web application with correlated, parameterised scripts, a monitored scenario on two load generators, SLA analysis and a final report.
checks: The report states SLA results and advice

intermediate.summary: For LoadRunner users who script and run tests and now handle complex applications and team workflows. Covers TruClient browser scripts, Web Services and REST, DevWeb with JavaScript, advanced correlation, data management, file handling, modular scripts, script maintenance across releases, advanced Controller features, network virtualisation, APM integration, advanced Analysis, LoadRunner Enterprise projects and test runs, the cloud edition, Jenkins and CI, version control for scripts, running JMeter and Gatling scripts in LoadRunner, endurance and stress tests and reporting to stakeholders.
prerequisites: Scripts Web HTTP/HTML tests with correlation and parameters
Runs Controller scenarios and reads Analysis
Has written at least one performance report
outcomes: Script complex applications with TruClient, REST and DevWeb
Run advanced scenarios with network virtualisation and APM monitoring
Work in LoadRunner Enterprise and the cloud edition with CI and version control
Analyse and report endurance, stress and comparison results

subtopics: When protocol scripts are not enough
Transactions and think time in TruClient
Resource cost of browser virtual users
days.lab_task: Record a TruClient script for a single-page application journey, make object identification stable, add transactions and run five browser users alongside protocol users.
checks: Browser and protocol users run together

days.topic: Web Services and REST API Scripts
days.lab_task: Write an API script without recording for create, read and search calls with JSON bodies, token authentication and JSON extraction, and run it at three loads.
checks: Calls use correct bodies and headers
Results are recorded at three loads

subtopics: Running DevWeb scripts in the Controller
days.lab_task: Write the shop journey as a DevWeb script in JavaScript with extractors, checks and data files, run it in the Controller and compare maintenance with the C script.
checks: The DevWeb script runs the journey
The script runs in a Controller scenario

subtopics: Correlating values in JSON and headers
days.lab_task: Build correlation rules for an application with arrays of dynamic values and redirects, share them with the team and prove the script works for fifty users.
checks: Rules are exported for the team
Fifty users run without correlation errors

subtopics: Data volume for long and large tests
Virtual Table Server for shared data
days.lab_task: Prepare data for a two-hour test on two generators, share consumable data through the Virtual Table Server and show that no data is reused.
days.deliverable: Data plan and Virtual Table Server setup
checks: No data row is used twice

subtopics: Reading and writing files in C
days.lab_task: Script document uploads of three sizes and an invoice download, measure their times under load and check the downloaded content.
checks: Size effects on time are reported

subtopics: Splitting scripts into actions and files
days.lab_task: Move login, search and error handling into a shared function library used by three scripts, and change one function in one place.

subtopics: Script health checks before load tests
days.lab_task: Update three scripts after an application release, compare old and new recordings, fix the differences and add a pre-test health check run.
checks: All three scripts replay on the new release
The health check runs before the load test

days.lab_task: Build a scenario with group schedules, IP spoofing for a load balancer test, SLAs and a template, and run it from the command line.
checks: Requests come from several IP addresses
The scenario runs from the command line

subtopics: Latency, bandwidth and packet loss profiles
days.lab_task: Run the same scenario with office, 4G and poor network profiles and report how each profile changes transaction times for key steps.
checks: Transaction times are recorded per profile

days.topic: APM Integration: Dynatrace, AppDynamics and Others
subtopics: Why APM data matters in load tests
Viewing load test transactions in APM
days.lab_task: Tag load test requests for an APM tool, find the slowest service and query for a slow transaction and retest after a fix.
checks: Load test requests appear in APM
The slow service and query are found

days.topic: Advanced Analysis: Correlating, Comparing and Cross-Run Results
subtopics: Building analysis templates for the team
days.lab_task: Compare three runs with cross-result graphs, use auto-correlation to find metrics linked to slow transactions and save an analysis template.
checks: Three runs are compared on key graphs
The template is saved and reusable

days.topic: LoadRunner Enterprise: Projects, Tests and Timeslots
subtopics: Running tests from the web interface
days.lab_task: Upload scripts to a LoadRunner Enterprise project, design a test, book a timeslot, run it and review results and trends.
checks: Scripts are stored in the project
A timeslot is reserved with hosts
The test runs and results are available

days.topic: The Cloud Edition: Testing from the Cloud
days.lab_task: Run a test from cloud generators in two regions, reach a private application through an on-premises generator and compare effort and cost with the Controller.
checks: The test runs from two regions

subtopics: Why run LoadRunner tests in pipelines
Running Controller or Enterprise tests from Jenkins
Pass and fail thresholds in pipelines
days.lab_task: Trigger a LoadRunner Enterprise test from Jenkins after a build, apply SLA thresholds to pass or fail the build and publish the results.
days.deliverable: Jenkins pipeline with a performance stage
checks: Results are linked from the build

subtopics: What to commit and what to ignore
Linking scripts to tests in Enterprise
days.lab_task: Put scripts in Git with an ignore file, review a script change in a pull request and record team conventions for script changes.
checks: Scripts are stored without generated files
A change is reviewed in a pull request

subtopics: Support for JMeter, Gatling and other scripts
Running a JMeter script in a Controller scenario
days.lab_task: Run a JMeter script and a VuGen script together in one scenario, analyse the combined results and note the limits of mixed runs.
checks: Both scripts run in one scenario
Limits of mixed runs are recorded

days.topic: Endurance and Stress Tests with LoadRunner
days.lab_task: Run a four-hour endurance test and a stepped stress test, find any degradation trend and the breaking point, and report recovery behaviour.
checks: The endurance test completes with trends recorded

days.topic: Reporting to Stakeholders and Release Decisions
days.lab_task: Prepare a release report from several LoadRunner runs with SLA tables, trends, bottlenecks and a recommendation, and present it to role-played stakeholders.
days.deliverable: Release performance report and presentation notes
checks: The summary states results against SLAs

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Performance Campaign for a Complex Application
days.lab_task: Run a performance campaign for a complex application with mixed protocols, shared data, network profiles, Enterprise or cloud runs, APM-linked analysis and a release recommendation.
checks: Load, stress and endurance tests complete

advanced.summary: For senior performance engineers and leads who run LoadRunner in large organisations. Covers enterprise performance programmes, protocol strategy, SAP, Citrix and mainframe testing, very large distributed tests, LoadRunner Enterprise administration, licensing and virtual user planning, governance of test assets, service virtualisation, continuous performance testing, cloud and hybrid generators, advanced analysis and modelling, capacity planning, production-like environments, tool strategy and migration, security of test assets, team enablement and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has run full performance campaigns with LoadRunner
Works with development, operations and vendors
outcomes: Lead enterprise performance programmes on LoadRunner
Test SAP, Citrix, mainframe and other enterprise systems
Administer LoadRunner Enterprise, licences and generator fleets
Set tool strategy, governance and capacity plans with evidence

subtopics: Performance across a portfolio of applications
days.lab_task: Plan a performance programme for ten applications with risk-based selection, a release calendar, environment allocation and measures, and present it to leadership.
checks: Test windows fit the release calendar

days.lab_task: Write a protocol strategy for five enterprise applications, covering web, API, SAP GUI, Citrix and a mainframe terminal, with costs and maintenance effort.
checks: Each application has a protocol with reasons
Licence and maintenance costs are estimated

days.topic: SAP Performance Testing: SAP GUI and SAP Web
subtopics: SAP monitoring with transaction codes and Solution Manager
days.lab_task: Script an order-to-cash flow in SAP GUI, correlate dynamic values, run it with background jobs and review SAP response times with the Basis team.
days.deliverable: SAP scripts and results with Basis review
checks: The SAP flow replays for many users
Background jobs run during the test
The Basis team reviews server-side metrics

subtopics: Alternatives such as TruClient for web front ends
days.lab_task: Script a Citrix-hosted application with text and image synchronisation, run it to find users per server and report the capacity limit.
checks: Scripts wait on text or images reliably

days.lab_task: Script a terminal transaction with screen synchronisation, run it alongside a batch job and review CPU and response data with the mainframe team.
checks: Online load runs with the batch job
The mainframe team reviews the metrics

subtopics: Planning tests with tens of thousands of users
Generator fleets on premises and in the cloud
days.lab_task: Plan a test at ten times normal load with a generator fleet, staged ramp-up and abort criteria, and run a scaled rehearsal that proves the plan.
days.deliverable: Large test plan and rehearsal results

days.lab_task: Configure projects, roles, host pools and timeslot rules for three teams, plan an upgrade and produce a usage report.
days.deliverable: Administration configuration, upgrade plan and usage report
checks: Teams have projects, roles and pools
The upgrade plan covers backup and rollback

days.topic: Licensing, Virtual User Planning and Costs
days.lab_task: Forecast a year of virtual user needs by protocol from the programme plan, compare licence options and present a cost recommendation.
checks: Needs are forecast by protocol and month

subtopics: Standards for scripts, scenarios and reports
days.lab_task: Write standards for performance assets, review ten existing scripts against them, retire obsolete ones and report compliance by team.
days.deliverable: Standards, review results and compliance report
checks: Standards cover scripts, scenarios and reports
Ten scripts are reviewed and fixed

days.lab_task: Replace an unavailable payment system with a virtual service that has a realistic response profile, run the test and state how virtualisation affects confidence.
days.deliverable: Virtual service, results and confidence statement
checks: The virtual service handles the payment calls
Response times follow the agreed profile
The report explains the effect on confidence

days.lab_task: Set up per-build checks and nightly tests through CI and LoadRunner Enterprise with baseline comparison and SLA gates, and report trends after a week.
days.deliverable: Continuous testing setup and trend report
checks: Each build runs a short check
Nightly results are compared with baselines

days.topic: Hybrid Generators: On-Premises, Cloud and Containers
days.lab_task: Run one test from cloud, on-premises and containerised generators together, compare results by location and recommend a generator mix.
checks: All three generator types take part
The mix is justified by cost and access

subtopics: Regression from load to response time
days.lab_task: Export raw data from several runs, model response time against load, predict the load at which SLAs break and state the uncertainty.
checks: The SLA breaking point is predicted

subtopics: Reviewing plans with operations and finance
days.lab_task: Build a capacity plan for an application from LoadRunner results and production metrics with headroom and growth, and review it with role-played operations and finance.
checks: The plan uses test and production data
Operations and finance agree the plan
Tracking of actual use is set up

days.lab_task: Compare the performance environment with production, run a readiness check before a test and write the limits statement for the report.
days.deliverable: Comparison, readiness check and limits statement
checks: The readiness check runs before the test
The report states what results predict

days.topic: Tool Strategy and Migration Between LoadRunner and Open Source
subtopics: Strengths of LoadRunner and open-source tools
Protocol needs that require commercial tools
Migration from LoadRunner to JMeter or k6
Migration from open source to LoadRunner
days.lab_task: Compare LoadRunner with two open-source tools for a portfolio, choose a mixed strategy, migrate one web script and compare results and effort.
days.deliverable: Tool strategy, migrated script and comparison
checks: Tools are compared on protocols and cost
The migrated script reproduces the workload
The strategy explains which tool covers what

days.topic: Security of Performance Test Assets and Environments
days.lab_task: Scan scripts and data files for credentials and personal data, move secrets to secure storage, review generator access and write a security checklist.
checks: Credentials and personal data are found

days.topic: Building a LoadRunner Centre of Excellence
days.lab_task: Design a performance centre of excellence with services, templates, a training path and measures, and present it to leadership.
days.deliverable: Centre of excellence plan and presentation
objectives: Build a performance centre of excellence

subtopics: Results that do not make sense
days.lab_task: Diagnose four problem runs (correlation failing under load, a saturated generator, a firewall drop and missing monitor data), fix them and write a troubleshooting guide.
checks: Each problem has a confirmed cause
The guide covers the steps used

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Performance Programme on LoadRunner
days.lab_task: Design an enterprise performance programme on LoadRunner for a portfolio of applications with protocol and tool strategy, platform design, continuous testing, capacity and licence plans, run a key test and present it to leadership.
days.deliverable: Programme plan, test results and presentation
checks: The programme covers portfolio, tools and platform
A key test runs with SLA results
